title: Great until it’s gone
body: I was using habit every day and found it really great for tracking my goals. Until one day, after years of use, all of my data and goals disappeared completely. I’ve emailed you multiple times but heard nothing. Really disappointing.
author: Alexhawkhead

title: Abandoned app
body: Do not buy. I haves purchased the premium version for widgets on iOS but there are none. The developers have not responded to me on their instagram. This app has been abandoned
author: Gaius Octavius x

title: No support, not working
body: My app at the premium level I have paid for is not working. I don’t get reminders and it doesn’t sync with my watch. Have emailed support and get no response. Frustrating ware of $17
author: Ccfromnz

title: Please fix these glitches
body: I like the app and the layout a lot. I use it often. However it is very glitchy. When you change the title of your habit the score changes too, this frustrates me. Also very often the ticks disappear, so you can’t keep accurate tracking, which is whole point of the app… please fix these as I really like it the concept and UI
author: Be3an3

title: Really enjoy the app, but could use extra features
body: I really enjoy the app, been using it for almost 2 years now. It would be cool to have option of archive habits you don’t do anymore but want to see your past progress, and adding emojis/designs for certain common habits like reading/exercise
author: Stellbory

title: Total scam
body: I paid for lifetime access to this app a few months ago (before the subscription model was introduced), however now I have to pay for the subscription for this app to be even a little bit useful. Have contacted the developers in every way possible, but no reply for weeks already. Stay away from this app because it’s a straight-up scam, and furthermore they don’t care about user privacy at all!
author: JvdK-94

title: Love this!
body: I really enjoy this app, it’s sleek and simplistic, there’s no pesky ads on the free version and it allows you to make several different habits to track. I’m amazed how much this motivates me!
author: kingpo2697

title: Habit is Awesome
body: Simplicity is the key. Easy to use, setup and maintain. Multiple goals to track is a bonus. Awesome work!
author: dhitd gift gff

title: Love it
body: Simple minimalistic design!!! So easy to use
author: fawnandboy

title: Love this app!
body: Great app, v simple and easy to use
author: kate-em24

title: Privacy nightmare.
body: Well designed, but you are the product here. The privacy policy is so wide open they can do pretty much anything they like with your data. Read between the lines of the privacy policy, it borders on cynical. There are plenty of good habit trackers you can pay for that aren’t camouflaged data collection schemes.
author: Ivanapinyon

title: Great app!
body: Love this app, helps me to keep on top of my habits.
author: sunshine222786
